story_fr: Eversource releve son plan d'investissement quinquennal 2026-2030 a 26,5 Md$, soit 2,3 Md$ de plus que le precedent, porte par la distribution electrique et gaziere.
story_en: Eversource raised its 2026-2030 five-year investment plan to $26.5 billion, $2.3 billion above the prior plan, driven by electric and natural gas distribution.
quote: Eversource released its new five-year $26.5 billion investment plan for the years 2026 to 2030, which is an increase of $2.3 billion dollars over its previous plan of $24.2 billion

story_fr: Apres la cession de ses actifs eoliens offshore, Eversource se positionne en utilite purement regulee avec de solides perspectives de croissance et un objectif de BPA en hausse de 5 a 7% par an jusqu'en 2030.
story_en: After divesting its offshore wind assets, Eversource is positioned as a pure-play regulated utility with solid growth prospects and a 5-7% annual EPS growth target through 2030.
quote: We are very excited about Eversource's future as a pure-play regulated utility company with solid growth opportunities

story_fr: Une decision de la FERC du 19 mars 2026 abaisse le taux de rentabilite (ROE) du transport en Nouvelle-Angleterre de 10,57% a 9,57%, entrainant une charge apres impots de 43,9 M$ et une revision de la guidance 2026.
story_en: A March 19, 2026 FERC decision cut the New England transmission ROE from 10.57% to 9.57%, triggering a $43.9 million after-tax charge and a 2026 guidance revision.
quote: the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) decision of March 19, 2026 that reduced the return on equity (ROE) rate for New England transmission owners from 10.57% to 9.57%.

story_fr: Eversource conteste la decision FERC via un depot Section 205 proposant un ROE de remplacement de 11,39%, attendu en vigueur cette annee sous reserve de remboursement.
story_en: Eversource is challenging the FERC ruling via a Section 205 filing proposing a replacement ROE of 11.39%, expected to take effect this year subject to refund.
quote: proposing a replacement ROE of 11.39% based on current market data... The new ROE rate of 11.39% is expected to be effective later this year on a subject to refund basis.

story_fr: Au T1 2026, les equipes d'Eversource ont gere un Nor'easter historique avec conditions de blizzard, chutes de neige record et nombreuses pannes, illustrant la robustesse operationnelle de ses pres de 11 000 employes.
story_en: In Q1 2026, Eversource's teams managed a historic Nor'easter with blizzard conditions, record snowfall and widespread outages, showcasing the operational resilience of its nearly 11,000 employees.
quote: highlighted by our team's strong response to a historic Nor'easter that brought blizzard conditions, record snowfall, and a significant number of power outages to our service area
